configurations.name: lamazon-api
runtimeArgs: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd backend && go run .

configurations.name: lamazon-website
runtimeArgs: cd Lamazon_website && ~/go/bin/templ generate && npm run build && API_BASE=https://api.geltrax.engineer go run .

configurations.name: lamazon-api-nomail
runtimeArgs: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && unset RESEND_API_KEY && cd backend && PORT=8081 go run .

configurations.name: lamazon-website-local
runtimeArgs: cd Lamazon_website/templates && ~/go/bin/templ generate && cd .. && npm run build && API_BASE=http://localhost:8081 PORT=8101 go run ./cmd/server
